headline: Finnair Q3 Operating Profit Surges 66% on Higher Passenger Revenue
summary: Finnair reported a 66% surge in third-quarter comparable operating profit, driven by revenue expansion across its flight operations.
why: Finnair is Finland's primary carrier; its profitability gains reflect passenger yield trends and route network adjustments in European aviation.

impacts.name: Finnair
impacts.why: A 66% increase in operating profit demonstrates pricing power and revenue gains.
